atomic_promotion_rollback_result: PASS - a corrupted or missing staged artifact BLOCKS promotion and the prior promoted bytes stand byte-for-byte
csv_formula_safety: PASS - every exported cell passes through the Phase 7.2 csv_safe_cell neutralizer
currency_mixing_result: NEVER_COMBINED - a second currency in the source blocks with PHASE7_3_CURRENCY_MIX_BLOCKED and aggregates bucket per currency
decision_queue_note: 0 rows cleared a review threshold at the neutral default configuration: 113 of 114 source rows stay under the 10-click minimum required before any conversion or ACoS judgment, and the single converting row has 1 click. This is a truthful result for this dataset, not a failure.
determinism_result: PASS - repeated runs against the same source and configuration are byte-identical and never duplicate rows
known_limitations: There is no owner-declared target ACoS. Phase 7.3 ships 0.30 as an explicitly marked NEUTRAL_DEFAULT_OWNER_CONFIGURABLE and says so in the owner report; every judgment that depends on it is therefore provisional until the owner sets a real target.
Phase 7.3 analyses the Sponsored Products SEARCH TERM report only. Any other promoted Phase 7.2 report type blocks with PHASE7_3_UNSUPPORTED_REPORT_TYPE rather than being guessed at.
The T2 dataset is thin: 113 of 114 rows have zero orders and most have a single click, so the honest result is an empty owner decision queue at the default thresholds.
Attribution is read from the 7-day window fields only. A source lacking those columns yields NEEDS_OWNER_REVIEW rather than an inferred outcome.
runs/ is gitignored, so the live T2 Phase 7.3 package is NOT committed. Only this sanitized proof gate is.
lineage_verification: PASS - every analyzed row carries source_file, source_file_sha256, source_row_number, source_line_number, canonical_row_key and lineage_hash
malformed_numeric_result: NEVER_SILENTLY_ZERO - a float, negative or unparseable value is recorded INVALID, excluded from totals and counted in the data quality report
path_safety: PASS - assert_source_path_allowed refuses any read outside the promoted Phase 7.2 final/ directory
phase7_2_bugfix_summary: An idempotent Phase 7.2 re-run promoted an empty candidate over promoted rows, erasing them while still reporting promote=PASS. A run with nothing new to report is now a promotion no-op; an unverifiable prior state BLOCKS with PHASE7_REPORT_CARRY_FORWARD_BLOCKED instead of erasing data.
sanitization_note: States, counts, schema ids and reason-code vocabulary only. No campaign names, no search terms, no absolute paths, no raw owner report rows.
